newsitem.title: USA: FTC to review Boeing /McDonnell merger.
newsitem.headline: FTC to review Boeing /McDonnell merger.

text.p: Attorney General Janet Reno said Thursday the Federal Trade Commission will review any possible anti-trust implications of the proposed Boeing merger with McDonnell Douglas.
"My understanding is that the FTC will handle that," Reno said in answer to a question at a weekly news conference.

The proposed merger was announced at a joint news conference by officials of the two companies Dec. 15. At that time Boeing President and Chief Executive Officer Phil Condit said he expected the process to take about six months.
The review process was set off after the companies notified the government they planned to merge. However, the companies have never announced publicly that they made the filing.
